newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 256 OF OCTOBER 9, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 256 OF OCTOBER 9, 1996.

text.p: COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1913/96 of 2 October 1996 laying down the reduced agricultural components and additional duties applicable from 1 July to 31 December 1996 to the importation into the Community of goods covered by Council Regulation (EC) No 3448/93 under Agreements with Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania END OF DOCUMENT.
